title: CheckResult
description:
Memoised result of `check(tree_root, def_digest, toolchain_digest)`
(decomposition §1, item 2; X9①).

Canonical serialization is deterministic (sorted maps, fixed field order)
so the phase-B memo equals the phase-D evidence byte-for-byte.

Frozen by WP-00.

def_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the CheckDef body.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the check in milliseconds.

memo_key.description:
Memoisation key.

FROZEN FORMULA (doc-only, implementation in B2a/D1a):
`memo_key = SHA-256(len(tree_root) ‖ tree_root ‖ len(def_digest) ‖
def_digest ‖ len(toolchain_digest) ‖ toolchain_digest)` where each
length prefix is a 4-byte big-endian u32 and the inputs are UTF-8
bytes of the respective hex strings.

produced_at.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when this result was produced.

runner_ref.description: Reference to the runner that executed this check.

stderr_ref.description: Content-addressed ref to captured stderr blob.

stdout_ref.description: Content-addressed ref to captured stdout blob.

toolchain_digest.description: Content-addressed digest of the toolchain used.

tree_hash.description: Merkle tree root hash of the workspace snapshot used (hex).

Artifact.description: A (path, content-digest) pair in the artifacts list.

digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact content.

path.description: Relative output path of the artifact.
